notes: Known: Blomberg's 2013 comment in the entry (via Harminc-Sotak 1998) proves a(n)!=0 iff gcd(k,10^c) | rev(k), k=2n-1. Here an elementary proof of that full criterion: block k [x padded] [x reversed] rev(k) with 10^c x == -rev(k) mod 5^v, repeated 2 phi(m(10^L-1)) times (Euler). Lean: A083964_main (conjecture) and A083964_iff (criterion). Outside Lean: none.
